title: Emerald Gem
meta_description: Coastal charm meets convenience at Emerald Gem! In addition to beachy vibes, enjoy a deck, pool access, and the nearby beach at this seaside getaway.
description_expanded:
Emerald Gem is true to its name - this inviting coastal townhome is nestled a short 3 minutes away from the stunning beaches of the Emerald Coast. With pool access, Emerald Gem has everything you need for the perfect seaside getaway!

As you enter Emerald Gem, you'll be swept away by the inviting, coastal cottage feel. The interior boasts an open floor plan and beachy decor throughout. After a long day of fun in the sun, kick back and relax on the plush sectional sofa. The modern, fully equipped kitchen boasts an island with barstool seating and stainless steel appliances. You'll feel right at home preparing your favorite meal and enjoying the delicious food with family and friends around the dining table. The deck features a seating area and grill. Enjoy the ocean breeze as you sip your morning coffee, or fire up the grill for an evening BBQ.

Three bedrooms provide a comfortable retreat to rest and recharge before another day of seaside adventure. The primary bedroom and Bedroom 2 each feature a queen bed, while Bedroom 3 features a twin over full bunk bed - perfect for kids.

Emerald Gem offers options for both relaxation and fun during your stay. Head to the community pool where you can lounge in a shady poolside cabana, or soak up the sun while you play in the pool. For those seeking sandy shores and ocean waves, public beach access is only a 3-minute ride away!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Hub 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Laguna Beach, Watercolor Beach

\*Home Truths:\*
- This home allows pets for a fee. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- The home is in a Triplex. It's two stories and Emerald Gem is the furthest to the left.
- The Northside pool is heated seasonally but is subject to change at any time by the HOA for the community. We are not responsible for any change in the seasonal heating of the Northside pool in Prominence. No refunds for any change to the pool heated seasonally.

\*\*Parking Details:\*\*
2 Parking space available in front of unit on driveway.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
